stem: Meena counts the neem trees growing in her school garden in Jaipur on one morning in March. Her friend says this count is a population. Which condition must be true for Meena's count to be a population?

options.text: The count includes every plant and animal living anywhere in Jaipur.
The count includes only neem trees, all counted in the same school garden at the same time.
The count includes neem, mango and peepal trees counted in different gardens on different days.
The count includes all the neem trees in India, estimated from a book.

teacher.key_rationale: A population is a group of the same kind of organism counted in the same habitat at a given place and time. Only option B satisfies all three conditions: one species (neem), one place (school garden), one time (one morning in March). A mixes kinds and places, C mixes kinds and times, D drops the actual single habitat count.
